browse_synced_records_by_type_text_or_da: Find records by type, keyword or date.

record_on_your_phone_explore_in_the_clou: Record on your phone, explore in the cloud

this_record_was_not_found_or_was_deleted: This record was not found or was deleted.
this_session_cannot_perform_this_action: This session cannot perform this action.
unable_to_reach_the_cloud_check_your_con: Unable to reach the server. Try again.
unable_to_sign_in_check_your_connection_: Unable to sign in. Check your connection and try again.
unable_to_sign_out_try_again: Unable to sign out. Try again.
unable_to_verify_the_session_try_again: Unable to verify the session. Try again.

bill_statistics_unsupported: This server does not support bill statistics yet. Update the backend and retry.

bulk_paused: Saving paused. Reconnect and confirm editing access to continue.
